channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Jordan Made an Impressive Low-Top Frankenstein Sneaker Out of Its Greatest Hits
item.description: The Jordan Sixty Plus Low arrives as a low-top hybrid sneaker inspired by the brand's greatest models. Here's everything on the debut.

item.title: This Brand Isn’t Levi’s. So, Why the Levi’s Name?
item.description: Nobody has heard from Amoskeag, the denim producer behind Levi's first jeans for the best part of a century. Now, in Japan, the name resurfaces.

item.title: Class of Fossil High: Meet the Tastemakers Defining the Next Era of The Big Tic
item.description: Fossil is tapping into the Y2K iconography of yesteryear for its latest launch of the Big Tic, a limited-edition revival pulled straight from the late 90s and early aughts’ archives.

item.title: A Glorious "Wolf Grey" Jordan Sneaker Howls Again
item.description: The Air Jordan 5 "Wolf Grey" sneaker returns to the game in classic greyed-out glory. Here's everything on the rerelease.

item.title: adidas’ Strapped Mary Jane Sneaker Is a Chocolate-Layered Dessert
item.description: adidas' strapped-up Tokyo MJ sneaker appears in a new "Sandy Pink" colorway, resulting in its sweetest version yet.

item.title: adidas’ Lowkey Luxe Samba Sneaker Has a Feral Secret
item.description: The adidas Samba sneaker gets another wild yet luxe makeover, complete with fur, snakeskin touches, & clean colorways.

item.title: Veterans of C.P. Company & Stone Island Took a Quiet Brand Technical
item.description: Lowkey Japanese label Comoli has always fed its discerning audience slouchy shirts & easy tapered pants. Now, in a collaboration Ten c, it's getting technical.

item.title: Union’s Patching Together Incredible Jordan 1s One "Fragment" at a Time
item.description: Union LA & Fragment Design literally stitch together the perfect Air Jordan 1 sneaker for a coveted collaboration. Here's everything on the release.

item.title: Nike’s Balletcore Shox Falls Anything but Flat
item.description: Nike's Shox Z Calistra sneaker is a super dressed-up version of the Swoosh's best lifted sneaker.

item.title: adidas' Blinged-Out Skateboarding Superstar Shoe Is Literally Shining
item.description: SP5DER's take on the sleek adidas Superstar sneaker is a classic sneaker turned into a classy shredder.
